title: Fake Event Ticket Abroad
scenario: Near the venue, a seller offers digital tickets and wants an instant transfer.

answers.A: Transfer the full price before the ticket is verified.
answers.B: Use the venue box office or official ticket-transfer system.
answers.C: Use a protected marketplace with buyer coverage.
answers.D: Ask the seller to show the ticket barcode on a video call.

explanation: A screenshot or live barcode does not prove the ticket can be transferred. Use the venue or a protected marketplace.
proTip: A ticket is real when the venue can validate it, not when it looks convincing.
